question: Where should the salutation to Mantraśakti be placed in this step?
premises: The salutation is addressed to Mantraśakti.
The locus is the tip of the right hand.
inference: One should place the salutation 'obeisance to Mantraśakti' at the tip of the right hand.
plain_english: One should place the formula 'Obeisance to Mantraśakti' at the tip of the right hand.
